Banner.Description: At Sawaed Al Elm, we are passionate about transforming ideas into cutting-edge digital solutions. Specializing in software development, hardware integration, and mobile application design, we empower businesses to thrive in the modern technological landscape. Let’s build the future together.

OtherProjects.Title: Our Services

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: NFC Card System
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Smart NFC-enabled cards that allow users to instantly access your published media, social profiles, contact information, and images with a simple tap or QR code scan.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Software & Mobile Apps
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: We build robust server-side systems, intuitive front-end interfaces, and seamless mobile applications tailored to your business needs using the latest technologies.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Hardware Development
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: From concept to creation, we design and develop custom hardware solutions to power smart devices, embedded systems, and innovative electronics.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Cloud Computing
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Leverage the power of the cloud with our scalable infrastructure, DevOps practices, and secure deployment models to accelerate innovation and reduce IT costs.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Web & App Hosting
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Reliable and secure hosting services for your websites and applications with high availability, regular backups, and 24/7 technical support.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Training & Capacity Building
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Expert-led training programs in software, hardware, and modern tech skills to empower individuals and teams with practical, industry-relevant knowledge.

CoreProduct.Title: Our Core Product
CoreProduct.Name: Sawaed Elm
CoreProduct.Tagline: The all-in-one mobile platform connecting students, parents, teachers, administrators, and drivers — on Android, iOS, and Web. One app. Every role. Every school.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Academic Management
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Assignments, exams & weekly plans — teachers create, students submit, parents stay informed. Automated reminders and grade tracking built in.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Smart Social Feed
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Posts, reels & polls in a safe, school-only space. Privacy by design — zero content exposure outside the platform.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Direct Messaging
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Secure one-to-one chat for every school role. Smart reminders auto-follow unread messages so nothing falls through the cracks.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Real-Time Notifications
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Targeted push alerts for every event — absences, submissions, payments, bus arrivals. Smart scheduling, zero notification fatigue.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Attendance & Leave
CoreProduct.Features.Description: One-tap digital attendance with automatic holiday integration. Parents are notified the instant their child is marked absent or late.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Finance & Payments
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Structured instalment plans, automatic reminders, and real-time payment status for every family. No spreadsheets. No missed fees.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Transportation Tracking
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Live journey management for drivers, real-time drop-off confirmations for parents, and emergency alerts for the whole school community.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Sawaed AI Tutor
CoreProduct.Features.Description: A built-in AI study companion personalised to each student's name, grade, and language — available 24/7. Powered by permanently free AI models.
